conclusions.pointAccuracy: ESTBAN supplies municipality/agency identities and accounting balances; it does not supply a location of every credit operation.
conclusions.collectionStatus: No ESTBAN numeric balance file collected. No monthly ZIP size or latest period confirmed. Canonical page/API discovery did not yield a usable official file catalog in this pass; do not construct guessed file names.
